text:
maria: FYI — observed ~25% end-to-end throughput drop for multi-GPU TF pipeline when traffic crosses racks over EFA vs NVLink. Started after kernel-selector change that favored smaller CUDA kernels for long sequences.

sanjay: can you paste the micro-profiles + bucketed allreduce stats? is this compute or comm-bound?

maria: benchbot summary attached:
benchbot: SUMMARY: run=run/2026-03-17/0452 model=llama-70b tp=2 pp=1 batch=2 seq=4096
  - tokens/s NVLink(local) = 620
  - tokens/s EFA(crossrack) = 470
  - avg allreduce wait NVLink = 18ms, EFA = 38ms
  - kv_cache_miss_rate NVLink = 0.09, EFA = 0.43

jin: the big kv miss delta is interesting. Could be our micro-split strategy touching many KV shards across devices, causing remote fetches + extra allreduces.

maria: pprof top (trimmed):
```
pprof: cpu profile
Time  %   Cum   Function
30.2  40%  40%  cuda_kernel_attention_split_small
15.1  60%  20%  allreduce_wait
9.0   69%   9%  kv_cache_eviction
6.5   75%   6%  memcpy_h2d
...
```

sanjay: looks like the selector increased small-attn kernel frequency. More micro-steps => worse KV locality. On NVLink those fetches hit local peers; across EFA we pay RTTs and extra synchronization.

maria: logs from runtime on EFA run when processing long shared prefix:
```
[2026-03-17T04:51:12Z] step=142 kv_fetch/shard=3 hit=false remote_fetch=true rtt=34ms
[2026-03-17T04:51:12Z] step=143 kv_fetch/shard=12 hit=false remote_fetch=true rtt=35ms
[2026-03-17T04:51:12Z] trigger=allreduce start wait=12ms
```
remote_fetch=true lines are absent on NVLink runs for same prompt.

jin: two mitigation axes: (A) kernel-selector bias to reduce micro-splits for long prefixes, (B) topology-aware KV-shard placement to keep hot prefixes local to NVLink peers. Also consider allreduce algorithm swap for cross-rack.

maria: quick experiment: increase kernel_pref.small_split_threshold 64 -> 128 + force allreduce=hierarchical on EFA cluster.
benchbot: EXPERIMENT: kernel_threshold=128 allreduce=hierarchical
  - tokens/s EFA = 540 (prev 470)
  - kv_cache_miss_rate = 0.21 (prev 0.43)
  - avg allreduce wait = 26ms (prev 38ms)

sanjay: improvement but still not parity with NVLink. Memory usage impact? larger micro-batches can raise resident.

maria: resident up ~6% but inside reserved headroom. eviction events down ~60%.

jin: note: kernel selector's cost model currently ignores remote_fetch penalty; it models kernel latency only. Propose adding topology-aware penalty term: remote_fetch_penalty = locality_factor * avg_remote_rtt. That will push the selector to prefer fewer splits when remote cost high.

maria: next actions:
  - jin: prototype topology-aware cost term + re-run selector sim (ETA 2d)
  - sanjay: prototype KV shard placement heuristic: prefer NVLink-local owner for client IDs with prefix-heavy traffic (ETA 3d)
  - ops: enable allreduce=hierarchical fallback for detected cross-rack fabric in runtime (ETA 1d)
  - sanjay: add runtime flag to throttle KV eviction for hot-prefixes (5s window) — low-risk toggle

jin: PR payload outline:
```
- runtime/kernel_selector: add topology_penalty factor
- runtime/allreduce: add hierarchical fallback when fabric!='nvlink'
- kv/cache: hot-prefix eviction throttle (5s)
```

maria: tagging @deploy-bot — schedule a canary on infra-staging with cross-rack EFA nodes to validate end-to-end.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: infra-staging/efa-crossrack at 2026-03-18T10:00Z duration=1h owner=maria

benchbot: also add a perf prompt-set with long shared-prefix distribution. Our random-token bench didn't surface this.

sanjay: also file a short eng-runtime/wiki note explaining topology-aware kernel cost and risk profile so oncall understands the change.

jin: will draft the wiki. attaching rough flamegraph pointers in the canary ticket after run.

maria: closing thread for now; reopen if regressions reappear after canary. :thumbsup:
